content.thinking:
This looks like a config-induced failure: the deploy changed the cache port from 6379 to 6380, which is wrong since the redis service is presumably still listening on 6379. The source code itself wasn't touched, just a broken config value pointing to the wrong port after deployment.

Even though the cache is optional by design, the elevated p50 latency (191ms vs 26ms baseline) and cache_hit_ratio dropping to zero make sense - requests are blocking on connection attempts to the unreachable port 6380 until they time out, adding latency even though the page renders fine without cache data. Though io-summary-cache is owned by checkout-platform, the actual break is io-shop's own config change pointing to the wrong port, not any unhealthiness in the cache service itself, so this is clearly config-induced-failure rather than internal-dependency-failure. I'm settling on high confidence around 0.93 for this classification.

hypotheses.subject: cache.port in deploy/values-production.yaml (io-summary-cache connection)
hypotheses.summary: The 15:59 deploy of io-shop changed deploy/values-production.yaml, moving the summary-cache port from 6379 to 6380. From 16:00 onward every request to the cache backend fails with 'connection refused' to cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380, and per-minute metrics show p50 latency jumping from ~26ms to ~190ms and cache_hit_ratio dropping to 0.0 at the exact same minute the deploy landed. The cache itself is otherwise healthy (it is reachable on 6379, per the prior working config) - the deployment simply pointed io-shop at the wrong port.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: summary cache lookup failed - connection refused to redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380 (200 of 200 requests)
p50_ms jumps from 27 to 191 and cache_hit_ratio drops to 0.0 starting exactly at the onset minute

hypotheses.subject: io-summary-cache
hypotheses.summary: If the port change were instead read as the cache dependency itself failing rather than a self-inflicted config error, this would be an internal dependency failure since io-summary-cache is owned by the same organisation (checkout-platform). However the diff clearly shows io-shop's own deployment changed the port value, which is the more direct explanation.

supporting_evidence.claim: io-summary-cache: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local
